links.comparator_used: OpenAI Omni Moderation Latest and NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails (other guardrail systems, not an unguarded conversational LLM)
links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity for detecting psychiatric crises in text messages
links.effect: VMHG sensitivity 0.990 and specificity 0.992 on the Verily dataset (F1 0.939); on the NVIDIA dataset sensitivity 0.982, accuracy 0.921, specificity 0.859. Versus NVIDIA and OpenAI guardrails: significantly higher sensitivity (all p < 0.001), comparable specificity (NVIDIA p < 0.001, OpenAI p = 0.094).
links.tradeoff: Specificity dropped to 0.859 on the NVIDIA dataset, so more false positives. The design prioritizes sensitivity to minimize missed crises.
links.quote: Compared with NVIDIA and OpenAI guardrails, the VMHG achieved significantly higher sensitivity (all p < 0.001) and comparable specificity (NVIDIA p < 0.001, OpenAI p = 0.094).
